verdict.rationale: Missive ships a first-party rules engine: plans include "Rules & automations" with up to 1000 rules. Rules can run multi-step over time, with each step waiting, checking its own conditions, and acting on the conversation (e.g., label at 24h, notify the lead at 48h, reassign at 72h). Rules can also create drafts, and AI rules are mentioned. missing for 10: a documented catalog of trigger events and available actions (the evidence shows only changelog and pricing snippets, not in-depth rules docs), plus independent or hands-on corroboration that rules work as described.
